description: Nucleoid keeps squared residual energies live as samples arrive
code:
residuals = [-3, 2, -1]
energies = residuals.map(value -> Math.square(value))
assert(energies, [9, 4, 1])
assert(energies.sum(), 14)
residuals.push(4)
assert(energies, [9, 4, 1, 16])
energies.sum()

description: Nucleoid derives independent squared amplitudes with class rules
code:
class Reading(amplitude):
    this.amplitude = amplitude
$Reading.energy = Math.square($Reading.amplitude)
first = Reading(-3)
second = Reading(4)
assert([first.energy, second.energy], [9, 16])
first.amplitude = 2
assert([first.energy, second.energy], [4, 16])
[first.energy, second.energy]

description: Nucleoid retains ignored extra subscriptions when squaring a live reading
code:
probe = {amplitude: -3, extra: 1}
energy = Math.square(probe.amplitude, probe.extra)
assert(energy, 9)
delete probe.extra
assert(energy, undefined)
probe.extra = Number.NaN
assert(energy, 9)
probe.amplitude = 4
assert(energy, 16)
energy

description: Nucleoid squares intrinsically converted values without exponentiation
code:
squares = [Math.square(" -2.5 "), Math.square(["-3"]), Math.square(true), Math.square(null)]
assert(squares, [6.25, 9, 1, 0])
assert(Number.isNaN(Math.square()), true)
assert(1 / Math.square(-0), Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
assert(Math.square(-3, "ignored", Number.NaN), 9)
squares
